GiftingSettings.title: Gifting Settings
GiftingSettings.description: Master switch and mobile feature flags for Android APK gifting

isGiftingEnabled.description: Whether gifting is active in the mobile APK

isTangoCardDirectGiftEnabled.description: Whether direct eGift card issuance is enabled

updatedBy.description: Admin email who updated the settings

AdMobSettings.title: AdMob Settings
AdMobSettings.description: Master switch, placement, frequency, and remote controls for mobile AdMob ads

adsEnabled.description: Master advertising toggle - must be false by default

bannerAdUnitId.description: Production or test Banner Ad Unit ID

interstitialAdUnitId.description: Production or test Interstitial Ad Unit ID

bannerPlacement.description: Placement of the banner (BOTTOM or TOP)

interstitialTrigger.description: Natural trigger moment for interstitial ads

minActionsBeforeFirstAd.description: Minimum actions required before first ad eligibility

minimumSessionTimeSeconds.description: Minimum user session duration in seconds before first ad

cooldownMinutes.description: Cooldown period in minutes between consecutive interstitials

maxInterstitialsPerSession.description: Maximum interstitial ads permitted in a single session

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the configuration update

updatedBy.description: Admin UID or email who saved the configuration

Celebration.title: Celebration Event
Celebration.description: Celebration event record from Android app or Admin Console

/celebrations/{celebrationId}.description: Collection of user celebrations and gift pools
